messages:
Alex Chen: Quick draft — Micro-STAR snippets for self-reviews. Goal: make 1–2 sentence, scan-friendly lines per competency (impact, collab, craft). Intended for ICs + a manager quick-scan. Thoughts?
People Ops Bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwoodinference.docs/micro-star-selfreview (short guide + examples). Reminder: keep entries concise.
Mira Patel: Love it. Suggest 3 micro sections: Situation (1 line), Task (1 line), Action (1–2 bullets), Result (single metric/impact). Then a one-line summary for calibration.
Alex Chen: Example (product): Situation: activation funnel dropped 20% after launch. Task: identify root cause and recover activation. Action: ran cohort funnel analysis; shipped onboarding A/B with updated copy. Result: +12% activation in 2 weeks. One-line: Diagnosed activation drop and shipped onboarding changes that recovered +12% activation in 2 weeks.
Jamal Ortiz: Add a tiny "What I learned / next step" line for growth signals managers love. e.g., Learned that early success CTAs move needle; next: instrument guidance for cohort B.
Sarah Nguyen: @Alex can we add short scan tags like [impact] [collab] [ownership] so reviewers can filter quickly during calibration?
Leo Park: small nit: for eng, include p90/p95 numbers where relevant (e.g., reduced p95 latency by 40ms) — makes the result concrete.
Alex Chen: Nice — I'll fold these in. Quick ask: can people drop 2 sample manager-ready phrases for upward feedback? e.g., 'Elevated cross-team blockers early and secured runway'
Mira Patel: Two manager phrases: 1) 'Partnered with X team to remove a critical dependency, enabling on-time ship.' 2) 'Coached direct reports on tradeoffs; outcome: Drove autonomy and shipped feature with no rework.'
People Ops Bot: Doc updated with examples + manager phrasing. Self-reviews due this Fri 11:59pm PT — please paste micro-STAR lines into the form. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
